---
title: Institution-Specific Notes
format: md
---

**NIH.** The page is `/studier/emner/{year}/{host|var}/{code}.html` with the
code in lower case and the Norwegian letters written as ASCII (KRØ100 →
`kro100.html`; `add_course_url_nih()`). The year indexes
(`/studier/emner/{year}/{host|var}/`, paged with `?page=n&u-page=n`) list
only the courses that have a page: 5 for 2021, 22 for 2022, 163 for 2025. A
404 for a course the index of its year does not list is final: NIH has no
page for it (`data/data_notes.qmd`, NIH).

**NMBU.** The page is `https://www.nmbu.no/emne/{CODE}`, with the code
without Norwegian letters (MILJØ300 is `MILJO300`; with Ø, raw or
percent-encoded, the site answers 404; since 2026-10-22). Only the plan in
force is published (`plan_years = "current"`). A course whose plan is only in
English has a Norwegian page whose "Om dette emnet", and every accordion, says
only "Se engelsk emnebeskrivelse" or "See English text"; the harvest then
fetches the English page, `https://www.nmbu.no/en/course/{CODE}`
(`english_page` in the config, as at HVL, Nord and NTNU), which has the same
layout with English headings, and the row keeps the Norwegian URL. A pointer
page in the raw store gives no plan, and NMBU's snapshot is once a year, so
fetch it again with `harvest_all(courses, institutions = "nmbu")` for those
offerings alone.

**NORD.** The URL needs Norwegian characters in the semester parameter
(`HØST`/`VÅR`); ASCII `HOEST` falls back to a generic "Gjeldende
emnebeskrivelse" page without year-specific content. The site maps each
semester to its academic year (`VÅR&year=2023` gives the 2022/23 plan). For a
year it has no plan for, it shows the current plan, headed "Gjeldende
emnebeskrivelse (sist oppdatert 2026/27)"; `page_term` in the config reads that
year (as its autumn), and an offering whose page shows a later year gets no plan. Pattern:
`https://www.nord.no/studier/emner/{code}?year={year}&semester={HØST|VÅR}`.
A course taught in English has a Norwegian page that only says so ("Emnet
foregår på engelsk. Se engelske nettsider ..."); the harvest then fetches the
English page, `/en/studies/courses/{code}` with the same query, and the row
keeps the Norwegian URL (`english_page` in the config; HVL likewise, from
`/en/studies-at-hvl/study-programmes/courses/`).

**NTNU.** The URL has the year but not the semester. The year is the academic
year the page is for (`/2025` is "Studieår 2025/2026"), so a spring or summer
offering reads the year before (`url_year = "academic"`; HVL and OsloMet
likewise), and `read_harvest()` gives an offering the page at its URL
whichever offering it was fetched for. DBH's "-A" codes (MGLU1101-A) are the
site's code without the suffix. A page saying no
information is available raises `ntnu_no_info_error`. robots.txt asks for a
10-second crawl delay (`request_delay` in the config). The page's exam tab
(`#omEksamen`: assessment form, grading scale, exam sessions and their parts)
is read without its link, rooms, comments, dates and times; the assessment
section gets one session of it (`exam_sessions`). The timetable tab
(`#timeplan`, from 2025) is not read. A course whose plan is only in English
has a Norwegian page whose course content is only a pointer to the English
page, in some 60 wordings ("Se engelsk versjon", "Emnet undervises på
engelsk. Se engelsk versjon for emnebeskrivelse.", "Se emnets engelske
nettside -- International MSc", "Cf. English description"; some 1,900
course-years of 2019-2025, 2026-11-05); the harvest then fetches the English
page, `https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/courses/{code}/{year}` (`english_page` in
the config, as at HVL and Nord), and the row keeps the Norwegian URL. Every
page has a link titled "English version" in its template, so the notice is
the course content paragraph, not the link. A pointer page in the raw store
gives no plan, so after `tar_make()` `harvest_all(retry = "ok")` fetches it
again (with `institutions = "ntnu"` and the years, and not while an NTNU
harvest runs: a retry removes the institution's checkpoints).

**HVL.** A course whose plan is only in English has a Norwegian page whose
content is only a pointer to the English page, its first paragraph, in some
30 wordings ("Emnebeskrivelsen finnes kun på engelsk, gå til ...", "Dette
emnet er kun skildra på engelsk. Klikk på "English" ...", "Dette emnet kan
du lese om på dei engelske nettsidene våre.", "Se engelske nettsider for mer
informasjon", "You can read about this course on our English website.";
some 250 course-years of 2017-2025, 2026-11-08); the harvest then fetches
the English page, `/en/studies-at-hvl/study-programmes/courses/{year}/{code}`
(`english_page` in the config), which has the same layout, and the row keeps
the Norwegian URL. A pointer followed by a plan in the same content (a
Norwegian plan after "For English course description, choose ...") is not the
notice. A pointer page in the raw store gives no plan, so after `tar_make()`
`harvest_all(institutions = "hvl", retry = "ok")` fetches it again (not while
an HVL harvest runs).

**UiO.** UiO publishes only the latest version of each course plan: the base
URL always returns the current plan and older versions cannot be reached.
Semester URLs (`/h24/`, `/v25/`) hold logistics only (teachers, timetable, exam
dates), not the plan, so they are not used. Data should be filtered to the
current year. The URL holds a faculty and department folder that DBH does
not give: `https://www.uio.no/studier/emner/{faculty}/{department}/{CODE}/`.
`resolve_urls_uio_batch()` reads the folders from UiO's sitemap
(`uio_course_folders()`), which lists every course taught now (the same
courses as the listing `/studier/emner/alle/`). A course not taught now keeps
its page but is not listed: it gets the folder that most listed courses with
its code prefix (`ENG`) have, else the one of its DBH department
(`department_code`); a wrong guess is a 404. A few folders are named in lower
case (`sv/iss/sos9009`), and the URL must be too; Ø is O (`MØNA2504` is in
`hf/ikos/MONA2504/`).

**UiB.** A page is
`https://www4.uib.no/studier/emner/{code}?start_semester={year}{V|H}` (the
code in lower case, a space as `%20`; summer is H). A course has one page
with a semester picker back to 2004; a course UiB no longer offers, a
master's thesis, a UNIS course and most PhD courses have no page in any
semester (404). UiB's site also answers 404 now and then for pages it has: in the
pilot of 2026-10-17, 29 of the 74 course-years that answered 404 gave a page
on 2026-10-21. After a harvest and `tar_make()`, run `harvest_all(institutions
= "uib", retry = "not_found")` once.

**HiOF.** A page is `/studier/emner/{folder}/{year}/{var|host}/{code}.html`
(one page per semester, the code in lower case), in a faculty or department
folder DBH does not give: `lusp/{lusp,pil,res,slik}/`, `hvo/{shb,vlo}/`,
`iio/{itk,ing,ois}/` (from 2021), `nta/` (2009–2021), `videre/` (from 2008),
`fellesemner/` (from 2022), and `historiske-emner/{hv,ir,it,lu,oss}/` for
courses no longer taught (2005–2024, the faculties before 2021). A course
taught in English may have its page only in the English tree,
`/english/studies/courses/{folder}/{year}/{spring|autumn}/{code}.html` (the
same folders, `historical-courses/` for `historiske-emner/`): the Master in
Green Energy Technology (IRMGR), Applied Computer Science (ITI), the PhD
courses (PHDDS, `iio/iio/`) and the Academy of Performing Arts (`nta/`, with
pages for 2024 and 2025); the English pages have the Norwegian layout. The folder
follows the site, not DBH's department (hsb1209, a health code, is in `ir/`),
so `resolve_urls_hiof_batch()` (url_discovery) lists the year folders of
the harvest's years in both trees (`vortex_course_index()`: about 20 pages a
listing page, some 1000 requests for all years, 70 more for two years of the
English tree) and gives an offering the page of its
code, year and semester; of several, the teacher-education URL that
`add_course_url_hiof()` builds (`historiske-emner/lu/` before autumn 2021,
`lusp/lusp/` after), then a Norwegian page, then one outside the historical
folders. A course over two semesters has one page, under its autumn
folder, titled "(Høst 2013–Vår 2014)": a spring offering without a page of
its own takes its course's page of the autumn before, and the title's
semesters (`page_term`, `page_end_term`) give it the plan only when the page
is for its spring too. Most offerings still without a page are the other semester of a course
DBH registers in both, or a code the site has no page for in that year (an
old code version DBH still registers, a course not taught that year). An offering with no
page gets no URL, unless the listing of its teacher-education year folder
failed: then it gets that URL. The config selector lists fallbacks for the
old and new page layouts.

**HiMolde.** Høgskolen i Molde's site is laid out as HiOF's (FS pages in
Vortex): a page is `/studier/emner/{folder}/{year}/{var|host}/{code}.html`,
in a department folder DBH does not give (`os/`, `log/`, `hs/`, `euv/` for
continuing education; `hogskolen-i-molde/` from 2026), from autumn 2018
(checked 2026-10-31; for 2017 only two pages, `log/2017/host/mar300.html` and
`mar301.html`). A year folder may list only its semester folders
(`os/2025/`), which `vortex_course_index()` then reads. A page is named by
the code without Norwegian letters (BØK705 at `bok705.html`). A course taught in English
may have its page only in the English tree,
`/english/studies/courses/{folder}/{year}/{spring|autumn}/{code}.html`
(ADM120). `resolve_urls_himolde_batch()` (url_discovery) reads the year
folders of the harvest's years, and of the year before a spring offering's,
in both trees with `vortex_course_index()`, and matches them as HiOF's
(`vortex_match_urls()`, without a built URL): a course over two semesters
has one page under its autumn ("LOG954 Masteroppgave (Høst 2022–Vår 2023)"),
and the title's semesters (`page_term`, `page_end_term`) decide whether it
serves a spring offering. robots.txt disallows only `/vrtx`.

**NHH.** Norges Handelshøyskole shows only the plan in force
(`plan_years = "current"`): one page per course, `/emner/{slug}/`, named from
the course's title (`/emner/finansregnskap-i/`, `/emner/forecasting/`), and
for a course taught in English the same page at `/en/courses/{slug}/` (checked
2026-10-31). The slug changes with the title, so the sitemap's URLs answer 404
(`/en/courses/financial-accounting-i/` is now `financial-accounting-i-e/`),
and the course lists (`/en/for-students/courses2/`) cover only the courses
offered now. `resolve_urls_nhh_batch()` (url_discovery) searches each code once
with the Norwegian site search, `/sok/?q={code}`, which lists the course pages
of both languages with their code ("MRR451 (7,5 Stp)"), and takes the page of
the exact code (not "MRR451-OSL"), one not marked "(expired)" or "(not
offered)" first. The page shows the version of the current semester ("Høst
2026"); a course taught in spring links to the next semester's version
(`?displayNextTerm=true`, "Vår 2027"), which the harvest does not fetch. The
NHH Executive courses (AFA, MAB, SOL ...) have no course page. robots.txt
disallows only `/paraplyen`.

**NMH.** Norges musikkhøgskole publishes a study handbook per cohort,
`https://nmh.no/studiehandboker/startkull-{year}/`, from 2021 (checked
2026-10-31; no earlier handbook is on the site), each with a page per course
named from its title: `/emner/{slug}` (`/emner/akkompagnement`,
`/emner/masterarbeid-2`) and, from 2022, the electives' catalogue,
`/valgemner*/{slug}` (`/valgemner-2026-27/alexanderteknikk`). The page gives
the code in its facts box, and the handbook's course lists give each page's
code ("AKKOMP10 - Akkompagnement", "BARENS20/21 - Barokkensemble I og II").
`resolve_urls_nmh_batch()` (url_discovery) finds the lists in the study-plan
sitemaps (`sitemaps-1-section-studyplans_content-1-sitemap-p*.xml`) and reads
them (about 25 requests a harvest year). An offering takes the page of its
code in the handbook of the cohort that starts in its academic year (spring
2026: `startkull-2025`), else in the latest earlier handbook that lists the
code; of two pages of a code in one handbook (56 such pairs, mostly in 2021),
the first listed. The handbooks are copies of one set of plans, each cohort's
for all its years of study: a course of the second year in `startkull-2026`
is taught in 2027/28. Many DBH codes have no page: ensembles and
orchestra projects registered per number of projects (BLENS21-BLENS27,
OSINF60-OSINF72; the handbook has BLENS20 or none), exchange students'
courses (UTV*) and others, about half the codes of 2025. robots.txt (nmh.no,
www.nmh.no redirects there) disallows only Craft CMS's `/cpresources/`,
`/vendor/` and `/cache/`.

**KHiO.** Kunsthøgskolen i Oslo shows only the plan in force
(`plan_years = "current"`): a page per course version,
`https://khio.no/emner/{code}-{version}`, DBH's code with its version number
in lower case (`/emner/kk202-4`, `/emner/cdpr528-1`; checked 2026-11-01). The
code without a version, or one that does not exist, answers 404. The page has
no year and shows the version's plan as it is now. A version no longer taught
keeps its page with the title, the facts list and the plan's headings, and no
text under them (`/emner/kk202-3`, `/emner/kk202-1`):
`fetch_html_cols_single_khio()` treats it as a missing page ("Course version
without a plan (soft 404)", outcome `not_found`). The study programme pages,
`/studieprogrammer/{programme}`, list the course pages. A course taught in
English has a full Norwegian page and an English one at `/en/courses/{code}`;
the harvest reads the Norwegian one. The plan's headings are h2s ("Kort
beskrivelse av emnet", "Læringsutbytte for emnet", "Undervisning og
læringsformer", "Vurdering"), the coursework requirements under a paragraph
sub-heading ("Arbeidskrav for emnet er:"). robots.txt has only comments.

**Fjellhaug.** Fjellhaug Internasjonale Høgskole shows only the plan in
force (`plan_years = "current"`), one page per course code on
`fih.fjellhaug.no` (Craft CMS): `/emne/{slug}`, or for most courses taught
in English only `/en/subjects/{slug}` (BMM, TMM). The slug is the code in
lower case (`/emne/krle1001n`), for a few courses followed by the title
(`/emne/btm2003n-markusevangeliet-10-ects-stp`); the bare code of such a
course answers 404 (checked 2026-11-05). `resolve_urls_fjellhaug_batch()`
(url_discovery) reads the subject sitemaps, Norwegian and English
(`sitemaps-1-section-subjects-1-sitemap.xml`,
`/en/sitemaps-1-section-subjects-2-sitemap.xml`; about 170 pages), and
matches the code at the start of the slug; of a Norwegian and an English page
of one code, the Norwegian. DBH gives the courses taught at the Danish
campuses (Afdeling København, Aarhus) the suffix `-DK1` or `-DK2`, and some
variants `-IS` or `-EVU` (`BTM2008-DK1`, `BMM1001-IS`): they take the page of
the code without it, whose facts box names the campuses ("Aarhus,
København"). The page holds the plan twice, for wide screens (`h4`
headings next to a menu of the parts) and in accordions for phones; the
harvest reads the first and leaves out the menu and the accordions. Earlier
plans are only in PDFs: the programmes' study plans per semester from 2007
and a course catalogue for autumn 2026, listed on `/om-fih/arkiv-studieplaner`,
which the harvest does not read. robots.txt disallows only Craft CMS's
`/cpresources/`, `/vendor/`, `/.env` and `/cache/`.

**VID.** VID vitenskapelige høgskole has one page per course,
`https://www.vid.no/studier/emner/{slug}-{code}`, the slug made from the
title and the code in lower case, a space as a hyphen
(`/studier/emner/team-og-prosjektledelse-maverd-543`, `...-phd-dvp-902`;
checked 2026-11-01). A few codes have a second page, with a numeric id after
the code (`...-basos1020-1795878807970940938`), for another programme or
semester. The sitemap, `https://www.vid.no/sitemap.xml`, lists every course
page (717), and `resolve_urls_vid_batch()` matches the offerings' codes to
the URLs' ends; of a code's several pages it reads each once and takes the
one with a plan for the offering's semester. The page is rendered in the
browser (Enonic XP, react4xp) from JSON in a script tag
(`data-react4xp-ref="root"`): the course's title, code, credits, language,
duration and programmes, and `plans`, one per year and semester the course
is taught in, from spring 2024 to the next academic year (many spring 2024
entries have no text). The HTML the server sends has the facts box and an
empty semester picker, no plan. The harvest stores the page; the config's
`html_fn`, `vid_plan_html()`, gives the block reader the plan of the
offering's year and semester as HTML (title, facts list, an h2 per paragraph
and accordion: "Emnets innhold", "Hovedtemaer", "Læringsutbytte", "Arbeids og
undervisningsformer", "Obligatoriske aktiviteter", "Vurderingsordning", ...).
The plan's facts-box items ("Emnetype", "Obligatorisk undervisning",
"Totalt antall studentarbeidstimer", "Tilbys som enkeltemne", "Opptak til
enkeltemne"; `vid_fact_items`) join the facts list instead, so they are in
`course_plan` but in no section and not in the plan id.
A page with no plan with text counts as not found
(`fetch_html_cols_single_vid()`). robots.txt allows everything for all user
agents and blocks AI crawlers by name.

**PHS.** Politihøgskolen's course pages are FS pages in Vortex, laid out as
HiMolde's but without department folders:
`https://www.politihogskolen.no/studier/emner/{year}/{var|host}/{code}.html`,
the code in lower case with the Norwegian letters as ASCII (`avhorutd.html`
for AVHØRUTD) and a dash kept (`ma-910.html`, `forebygg01-2.html`), though a
few drop the dash or write æ as e (`elkrise.html` for EL-KRISE, `ledlerutv.html`
for LEDLÆRUTV; checked 2026-11-03), and an
English tree, `/english/studies/courses/{year}/{spring|autumn}/`, for the
courses taught in English (NCFI861-*), whose pages hold the title ("NCFI861-1
null (Spring 2025)"), the facts and the programmes and no plan:
`fetch_html_cols_single_phs()` counts a page without plan text as not found. The year folders run from 2022 to 2028
(checked 2026-11-02). The folders' listings hold every page, and an offering
they do not list answers 404 (checked again 2026-11-03: the sitemap, the
site search, the programme pages and 40 unresolved codes probed in every year
folder found no course page outside the listings), so `resolve_urls_phs_batch()` reads them
(`vortex_course_index()`, `vortex_match_urls()`). A course over two semesters
is filed under its autumn, with both semesters in its title ("(Høst
2025–Vår 2026)", `page_term` and `page_end_term`). The plan sits beside the
title and facts list in `#vrtx-content`, not inside `#vrtx-fs-emne-content`
as at HiMolde. The headings are h2s: "Innledning", "Læringsutbytte",
"Kunnskap", "Ferdigheter", "Generell kompetanse", "Organisering og
læringsaktiviteter", "Obligatorisk aktivitet", "Vurdering". Programme
study plans (`/studier/master-etter-og-videreutdanninger/{programme}/studieplaner/`,
HTML or PDF) are not read. robots.txt disallows `/vrtx`.

**FHS.** Forsvarets høgskole's course pages are on Forsvaret's site,
`https://www.forsvaret.no/utdanning/emner/{CODE}/{year}-{HØST|VÅR}` (the
code without DBH's version suffix, the semester in capitals and
percent-encoded), one page per version of the plan, for the semester the
version starts in, from autumn 2018 (checked 2026-11-04). A course taught
every year may have versions for some years only (MILM1701: autumn 2020,
2021, 2023, 2025). The code's page, `/utdanning/emner/{CODE}`, redirects to
the latest version, which lists them all in its "Emnehistorikk" menu; a code
without pages answers 404. `resolve_urls_fhs_batch()` reads each code's page
once and gives an offering the latest version that starts in or before its
semester, the one in force. The page is server-rendered HTML: the title, a
facts box (credits, academic year, programmes, English title), "Hva lærer
du" (paragraphs with bold sub-headings: "Innledning", "Emnets temaer") and
accordions with h3 headings ("Læringsutbytte", "Læringsaktiviteter",
"Pensum", "Arbeidskrav og vurdering", "Utfyllende informasjon om emnet").
The programme pages (`/utdanning/utdanninger/{slug}`) link the course pages
of their current versions; their study plans are not read. Forsvaret's
site has no robots.txt (404) and its sitemap answers 500.

**USN.** The URL holds a version number that metadata cannot give:
`https://www.usn.no/studier/studie-og-emneplaner/#/emne/{CODE}_{VERSION}_{YEAR}_{SEMESTER}`.
Each version (1, 2, 3, …) is a revision valid for a range of years, and an
invalid version/year combination silently shows another page without changing
the URL. `resolve_urls_usn_batch()` therefore renders each candidate in Chrome
(`rvest::read_html_live()`, hash routing) and checks that the displayed
"Undervisningsstart" semester matches ("Course start autumn 2022" on the
English page of a course taught in English, `usn_page_term()`). It tries versions 1-3 and stops early when
the course code is missing from the page (no such version) or version 1 starts
after the requested year (course did not exist yet); NA means no version exists
for that semester. The content is rendered inside Shadow DOM, which
`html_text()` cannot read; `read_usn_live_html(session)` walks the shadow roots
with JavaScript:

```{r}
#| eval: false
session <- rvest::read_html_live(url)
Sys.sleep(5)  # wait for JS rendering
content <- read_usn_live_html(session)
session$session$close()
```

The batch resolver reuses one Chrome session and navigates by changing
`window.location.hash`, which avoids a 2-3 s browser start per URL. It waits
the config's `request_delay` after each page (5 seconds, the Crawl-delay of
USN's robots.txt) before it reads it and asks for the next. A
semester without a plan of its own shows another semester's plan under the
banner "Emneplanen for dette semesteret er ikke klar ennå". When the next
candidate shows the same plan, the banner stays until the page is reloaded, so
a page with the requested year and the banner is reloaded. HTML is
captured during resolution, so USN has no separate fetch step.

**UiT.** Historical plans need a document id:
`https://uit.no/utdanning/emner/emne?p_document_id={ID}`. The active page
(`/utdanning/aktivt/emne/{CODE}`) shows the course's latest document and has a
`<select>` ("Andre år og semester") listing the other semesters with their
document ids (option text `{CODE}: H 2020` / `{CODE}: V 2021`), also for
discontinued courses. The shown document is not in the list: its semester is
under "Semester / år" and its id only in the login link
(`securerefresh?p_url=...?p_document_id=`); `uit_semester_documents()` adds it
(before 2026-10-21 it was missed, e.g. every course whose latest document is
autumn 2025). A semester listed twice can be an English document
("Course code:") beside the Norwegian one; `uit_one_per_semester()` fetches
those and keeps the first Norwegian one. The same CSS selector works for
active and historical pages.

**Samas.** `noop` strategy: `extracted_text` is NA, since the plans are in Sámi.
